summary: VERDICT: PASS. Confirmed find-924ed503 (CRITICAL, unvalidated client orderBy concatenated into TypeORM QueryBuilder.orderBy() SQL in artists.service.ts list()) is fixed via safeOrderBy() allow-list, same pattern applied consistently to marketing-projects/contents/assets.service.ts (behavior-preserving refactor, diffed and confirmed identical allow-lists/fallbacks). Verified all 5 allow-listed artist columns and all marketing entity columns exist in entities.ts with no PII/encrypted-column exposure. Confirmed ascending/direction is a validated boolean (PaginationDto @IsBoolean), not string-interpolated -- no residual injection via direction. Repo-wide grep for template-literal .orderBy()/.addOrderBy() calls found only these 4 call sites; every other ORDER BY in the codebase uses a hardcoded literal column name (client input only ever selects ASC/DESC), so no other instance of this injection class exists. Re-ran the 5 test suites (24 tests) independently -- all pass, including the 2 new negative tests proving a DROP TABLE payload falls back to created_at. security-verification-engine.mjs's one canonical finding (Private Key Block in apple-music.service.spec.ts:10) is an out-of-scope, pre-existing, clearly-labeled synthetic test fixture (not a real credential, not touched by this fix) -- FALSE-POSITIVE, not recorded as a new finding.
